title: Refactor Naming Conventions
problem_statement: Inconsistent naming conventions across forms and modules.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased difficulty in maintaining and understanding the codebase.
suggested_approach: Refactor all form and module names to follow a consistent naming pattern.
success_criteria: All forms and modules have consistent and descriptive names.

title: Implement Structured Error Handling
problem_statement: Lack of structured error handling in modules.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential for unhandled exceptions leading to application crashes.
suggested_approach: Introduce Try-Catch blocks in all modules to handle exceptions gracefully.
success_criteria: All modules implement structured error handling.
